'''Legovan Vader's Curse''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Legovan]]
* '''Published:''' 1 March 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star: Docking Bay 327|Premiere-D-deathstardockingbay327.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star: Docking Bay 327
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor DSDB Legovan DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Endor and Death Star Deck.

The published list has 59 cards.
